description: A qualified TYPE clause CONTROL HEADING / CONTROL FOOTING operand (kb/Work PB5910). §1985:III.2 says a general format's 'data-name' "must not be reference-modified, subscripted, or qualified unless specifically permitted by the rules of the format". The CONTROL clause permits it (§1985:XIII.3.7.3 SR1, "Data-name-1 may be qualified"); the printed TYPE clause (folio XIII-55, §1985:XIII.3.20.2 and §1985:XIII.3.20.3) does not: its SR4 asks only that data-name-1 and data-name-2 "must be specified in the CONTROL clause of the corresponding report description entry". ISO/IEC 1989:2002 adds it: 13.16.55.2 SR10 ("Data-name-1 and data-name-2 may be qualified and reference modified"), §2014:13.18.57.2 SR10 and §2023:13.18.57.3 SR10 the same. Asked in the ONE place that holds a control name's 1985 shape, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.GateCobol85ControlName, for the TYPE operand only (VisitReportControlName); the CONTROL clause's qualified operand stays COBOL-85. A subscripted TYPE operand is refused at every edition (COBOL0899), and a reference-modified one is report-control-reference-modification-2002.
display: a qualified TYPE clause control operand (report group description)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (85->2002: the TYPE clause's control operand may be qualified)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRTQ.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRTQ.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-GRP.
    02 WK PIC X(2) VALUE "AB".
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 CONTROL IS WK PAGE LIMIT IS 10 LINES.
01 CH1 TYPE CONTROL HEADING WK OF WS-GRP LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "CH".
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(2) VALUE "DE".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
